title: Northstar settlement export agreement
body: Effective September 2026, NORTHSTAR receives settlements, not invoices. Select the reporting month by settled_at converted to America/New_York (including daylight saving), not invoice_at or UTC month. Include PAID and REFUNDED records only; ignore PENDING and VOID before reading settled_at. Export this customer only. All other customers keep their existing invoice export unchanged. CSV columns in order: invoice_id,settlement_date,net_cents. settlement_date is the local YYYY-MM-DD. Sort by settlement_date, then invoice_id. Use standard CSV quoting and newline-terminated rows. For reporting periods before 2026-09, retain the existing invoice export format for NORTHSTAR too.

title: Settlement amounts and refunds
body: For PAID rows, net_cents = gross_cents - fee_cents. For REFUNDED rows, net_cents = -gross_cents: processing fees are NOT returned. gross_cents and fee_cents must be nonnegative integer USD cents, not booleans or floats. Reject included non-USD rows rather than performing currency conversion. settled_at must include a UTC offset. Never silently guess missing settlement dates.

title: Northstar export approval and delivery scope
body: Approved implementation scope: EXPORT-NS-1 and FIN-SETTLEMENT-2. Implement in app/exporter.py using the existing interface; add tests. Keep BLUEBIRD and other customers on their existing invoice CSV. Delivery means a reviewed code change and test evidence, not sending a customer file or changing production. The proposal EXPORT-NS-2-DRAFT is not approved.

title: Proposed UTC settlement export
body: Proposal for a future export: use UTC month and refund processing fees. This is awaiting customer and Finance approval. Do not apply it to September or existing exports.
